headings.usage: Use for all main titles, headers, and key numbers. Never use Inter for headings.

body.usage: Use for body text, labels, and data points.

typography.instructions_to_main_agent: Import Barlow and Inter from Google Fonts. Apply tracking-tight for headings > 32px. Use uppercase with tracking-[0.2em] for overlines and small labels.

background.description: Dark slate colors to provide a solid, professional construction-industry feel.

primary.description: Amber accent (Warning/Construction color) for main CTAs and highlights. Ensures high visibility on dark slate.

destructive.description: Use for critical issues and warnings in the analysis results.

success.description: Use for positive progress notes and completed stage badges.

colors.instructions_to_main_agent: Update index.css with these HSL values for the dark theme. The app MUST be in dark mode by default. Ensure text contrast meets APCA/WCAG standards (e.g., text-slate-200 for body on dark slate).

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use flat solid backgrounds with subtle 1px border (border-slate-700) and no soft shadows for cards. Apply the 'Grid Borders (The Technical Look)' for data-heavy sections if necessary. Avoid transparent backgrounds behind content.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: Interactive elements must have explicit text and background color changes (e.g., hover:bg-amber-400 hover:text-black). Apply -translate-y-1 on card hovers.
visual_enhancers.loaders: Use an industrial-feeling animated progress bar or a spinner in Amber for the 'Analyze' button state. It should feel mechanical and precise.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped or slightly rounded (rounded-md) with sharp interaction animations. Primary CTAs use Amber background with black text.
components.file_upload: A large drag-drop zone with a dashed border (border-dashed border-2 border-slate-600 bg-slate-800/30). Must include hover states (border-amber-500 bg-slate-800/50).
components.stage_hint_dropdown: Use Shadcn 'Select' component. Ensure it follows the dark theme, no transparent backgrounds in the dropdown menu.
components.analysis_result_card: A structured layout divided into 'Stage Badge', 'Progress Notes', 'Observations', and 'Issues'. Issues must be styled with warning aesthetics (amber/red borders or subtle warning backgrounds).
components.history_grid: Grid of past analyses (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3) with tight gaps (gap-6). Each item shows a thumbnail image and a summary.

spacing_and_layouts.general: Follow generous spacing for layout, but high density for data. Use p-6 or p-8 inside cards.
spacing_and_layouts.grid: Use the high-density grid pattern for the history section. Align items start.
spacing_and_layouts.page: Wrap the main content in a container with max-w-7xl. Provide a fixed sticky top header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-900/80 border-b border-slate-800) with the app logo (BuildManager VIC).

motion.transitions: Use specific transitions for buttons and cards (e.g., transition-colors duration-200, transition-transform duration-200). DO NOT use 'transition: all'.
motion.entrances: Staggered fade-in (opacity-0 to opacity-100, translate-y-4 to translate-y-0) for history cards using framer-motion.

accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='upload-dropzone', data-testid='analyze-button').

media.icons: Use lucide-react. Prefer clear, technical icons suitable for construction.

history_thumbnails.description: Worker on building frame - use as thumbnail for a 'Framing Stage' history item.
Workers pouring concrete - use as thumbnail for a 'Foundation Stage' history item.
Construction site with crane - use as thumbnail for a 'Lockup Stage' history item.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not make generic centered layouts. Use flat, sharp or slightly rounded corners (max 8px). Do not apply 'transition: all'. Never use text-align: center on the main app container. Add data-testid to all interactive elements. Ensure dark mode is explicitly configured. Use lucide-react for icons. Do not use AI emojis. Prioritize Shadcn UI components for dropdowns (Select) and buttons. Ensure all headers have explicit text color and tracking.
instructions_to_main_agent: Install and setup required Shadcn components: Button, Card, Select, Badge, ScrollArea.
Configure Tailwind for dark mode by default.
Implement the layout with a sticky header, main photo upload area, and history grid below.
Create a mock 'Analyze' function that simulates a 2-second loading state before showing the Result Card.
The Result Card must display: Stage Badge, Progress Notes (list), Observations (list), Issues List (styled distinctly as warnings).
